name: 35-caching-system-prompt-openrouter-string
description: The string-content branch of cachingSystemPromptForOpenRouter (:1104-1112) with the TTL argument **omitted**, so the `ttl ? {...} : {...}` at :1088-1090 yields the bare `{type: 'ephemeral'}` with no ttl key at all -- a fixture that passed `null` would compare the same, but omitting the argument is what the reference's own default (`ttl = undefined`) does. The first system turn is a plain string, so its content is *replaced* by a one-part array, not indexed. The array-content system turn in second place is not touched.
